Parking the whole roadmap. Since I have no tools this turn, here are the calls I'll run. **Nothing has been written or committed yet.**

**What parks.** Stage 1 is complete, so the roadmap is marked **1 of 2 stages complete**. Four items move to `specs/deferred_items.md`, one each:

| Item | From | Size | Done when |
|---|---|---|---|
| Closure notices (O5) | Stage 2, Track B | small: one closure-log poll every 10 min | the notice job and its operator mailing list exist, and an email reaches every list address within an hour of a new closure entry |
| 7-day closure-risk outlook per lock (O2) | Ranked list A, #1 | small: one model run a day, on Stage 1's 22-min fit | a daily 7-day outlook per lock, from the river-level forecast |
| Per-lock closure curves, pooled (O3) | Ranked list A, #2 | ~14× Stage 1's 1.8 GB, so ~25 GB; fit time unmeasured | separate pooled curves for all 14 locks |
| Closure-history map (O4) | Ranked list A, #3 | about a day | a static closure-history map page for boat operators |

Each item will say that Stage 1's curve (rising steeply above 3.1 m) and its cost are in `specs/lock-closures-stage-1-findings.md`. That way each item stands on its own once the roadmap is retired.

**Calls, in order:**

1. `Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/references/deferred-backlog.md` to get the Deferred-item schema. I'll fit the four items to its exact fields rather than the table above.
2. `Read specs/deferred_items.md`, if it exists, so I append to it rather than overwrite it.
3. `Edit specs/deferred_items.md` to append `## lock-closures-roadmap — <date>` with the four items.
4. `Edit specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md` to add, under the title, `PARKED (<date>) — 1 of 2 stages complete; remaining items in specs/deferred_items.md`.
5. `Bash: mkdir -p specs/completed && git mv specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md specs/completed/`
6. `Bash: git add specs/deferred_items.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md && git commit -m "Park lock-closures roadmap: funding ended (1 of 2 stages complete)"`

The roadmap has no spec, methodology or critique files, so nothing else retires with it. The findings file stays where it is, since the deferred items point to it.

**Two things to check:**
- **Date:** the session says today is 2026-11-06, but the system clock says 2026-11-27. I'll use **2026-11-27** for `<date>` unless you say otherwise.
- **Text-message notices** were only listed under Stage 2's `Leaves out`, with no stage or list item behind them. They don't become a deferred item unless you want one.
